title: Jagex announces RuneScape Reignited, a fresh-start mode with a separate economy
question: How will RuneScape players react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is Jagex likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: It would split the player base and shrink the veteran population.
It favours new players at the expense of long-time veterans.
It would become the default for new and returning players and drain the main game, with no way to carry accounts over.
Fixing current problems would attract and keep more players than wiping the board.

backdown.summary: After saying it was re-evaluating (6 Oct) and floating concessions (9 Oct), Jagex cancelled Reignited on 15 October; other new-player updates went ahead.

pushback_groups: community on social media and forums
notes: Negative, full backdown within 12 days. The 6 and 9 October interim steps come from the RuneScape Wiki only. Not to be confused with Old School RuneScape, which was not affected.
